import molecule = "./molecule.qui"

int distinct_count(const int[] values)
    ordered := values.sorted()
    result := 0
    for: index < int(#ordered)
        if index == 0 or ordered[index] != ordered[index - 1]
            result += 1
    return result

int[] dense(const int[][] values)
    int[][] unique_values := []
    for value := values[]
        if not molecule.has(unique_values, value)
            unique_values = unique_values.append(value)
    for: position < int(#unique_values)
        current := position
        while current > 0 and molecule.compare(unique_values[current], unique_values[current - 1]) < 0
            saved := unique_values[current]
            unique_values[current] = unique_values[current - 1]
            unique_values[current - 1] = saved
            current -= 1
    int[] result := []
    for value := values[]
        for: index < int(#unique_values)
            if unique_values[index] == value
                result = result.append(index + 1)
                break
    return result

int[] refine(const molecule.Molecule graph, const int[] initial)
    current_ranks := initial
    while true
        classes := distinct_count(current_ranks)
        int[][] values := []
        for: atom_index < int(#graph.atoms)
            int[][] pairs := []
            for neighbor := graph.neighbors[atom_index][]
                pairs = pairs.append([current_ranks[neighbor.atom], graph.bonds[neighbor.edge].kind])
            for: position < int(#pairs)
                current := position
                while current > 0 and molecule.compare(pairs[current], pairs[current - 1]) < 0
                    saved := pairs[current]
                    pairs[current] = pairs[current - 1]
                    pairs[current - 1] = saved
                    current -= 1
            combined := [current_ranks[atom_index]]
            for pair := pairs[]
                combined = combined.concat(pair)
            values = values.append(combined)
        current_ranks = dense(values)
        if distinct_count(current_ranks) == classes
            return current_ranks

class Ranks(int[] values, int classes)

Ranks rank_atoms(const molecule.Molecule graph, const map<string, molecule.Element> elements)
    int[][] invariants := []
    for: atom_index < int(#graph.atoms)
        molecule.Atom atom := graph.atoms[atom_index]
        molecule.Element info := molecule.lookup(elements, atom.element)
        invariants = invariants.append([int(#graph.neighbors[atom_index]), info.number, atom.mass, atom.charge, atom.hydrogens, if atom.aromatic then 1 else 0])
    current_ranks := refine(graph, dense(invariants))
    classes := distinct_count(current_ranks)
    count := int(#graph.atoms)
    while distinct_count(current_ranks) < count
        occurrences := array(nat(count + 1), fill = 0)
        for rank := current_ranks[]
            occurrences[rank] += 1
        tied := 1
        while occurrences[tied] < 2
            tied += 1
        selected := 0
        while current_ranks[selected] != tied
            selected += 1
        int[][] split := []
        for: atom_index < count
            split = split.append([current_ranks[atom_index] * 2 - (if atom_index == selected then 1 else 0)])
        current_ranks = refine(graph, dense(split))
    return Ranks(current_ranks, classes)

string lower_symbol(string element)
    uppercase := "BCNOPS"
    lowercase := "bcnops"
    for: index < 6
        if element == uppercase[index]
            return lowercase[index]
    return element

string atom_text(const molecule.Molecule graph, int atom_index, const map<string, molecule.Element> elements)
    molecule.Atom atom := graph.atoms[atom_index]
    symbol := if atom.aromatic then lower_symbol(atom.element) else atom.element
    allowed := molecule.has(["B", "C", "N", "O", "P", "S", "F", "Cl", "Br", "I"], atom.element)
    if atom.aromatic
        allowed = allowed and molecule.has(["B", "C", "N", "O", "P", "S"], atom.element)
    implicit_matches := false
    match graph.organic_hydrogens(atom_index, elements)
        int hydrogens
            implicit_matches = hydrogens == atom.hydrogens
        none
            implicit_matches = false
    same_pi := not atom.aromatic or graph.needs_pi(atom_index, elements, true) == graph.needs_pi(atom_index, elements, false)
    if allowed and atom.mass == 0 and atom.charge == 0 and same_pi and implicit_matches
        return symbol
    result := "["
    if atom.mass != 0
        result += string(atom.mass)
    result += symbol
    if atom.hydrogens > 0
        result += "H"
        if atom.hydrogens > 1
            result += string(atom.hydrogens)
    if atom.charge != 0
        result += if atom.charge > 0 then "+" else "-"
        magnitude := molecule.absolute(atom.charge)
        if magnitude > 1
            result += string(magnitude)
    return result + "]"

string bond_text(const molecule.Molecule graph, int edge)
    molecule.Bond bond := graph.bonds[edge]
    aromatic := graph.atoms[bond.first].aromatic and graph.atoms[bond.second].aromatic and bond.ring
    if bond.kind == 1
        return if aromatic then "-" else ""
    if bond.kind == 2
        return "="
    if bond.kind == 3
        return "#"
    return if aromatic then "" else ":"

molecule.Neighbor[] ordered_neighbors(const molecule.Molecule graph, int atom_index, const int[] keys)
    molecule.Neighbor[] result := graph.neighbors[atom_index]
    for: position < int(#result)
        current := position
        while current > 0 and keys[result[current].atom] < keys[result[current - 1].atom]
            saved := result[current]
            result[current] = result[current - 1]
            result[current - 1] = saved
            current -= 1
    return result

class Traversal(int[] visited, int[] edge_kinds, molecule.Neighbor[][] children)
    serial := 0

void visit(const molecule.Molecule graph, const int[] current_ranks, int atom_index, int incoming, Traversal &state)
    state.serial += 1
    state.visited[atom_index] = state.serial
    neighbors := ordered_neighbors(graph, atom_index, current_ranks)
    for neighbor := neighbors[]
        if neighbor.edge == incoming or state.edge_kinds[neighbor.edge] == 2
            continue
        if state.visited[neighbor.atom] == 0
            state.edge_kinds[neighbor.edge] = 1
            state.children[atom_index] = state.children[atom_index].append(neighbor)
            visit(graph, current_ranks, neighbor.atom, neighbor.edge, &state)
        else
            state.edge_kinds[neighbor.edge] = 2

class Writing(int[] assigned)
    text := ""

void write_node(const molecule.Molecule graph, const map<string, molecule.Element> elements, const Traversal traversal, int atom_index, Writing &state)
    state.text += atom_text(graph, atom_index, elements)
    neighbors := ordered_neighbors(graph, atom_index, traversal.visited)
    for neighbor := neighbors[]
        if traversal.edge_kinds[neighbor.edge] != 2
            continue
        number := state.assigned[neighbor.edge]
        if number > 0
            state.assigned[neighbor.edge] = 0
        else
            number = 1
            while molecule.has(state.assigned, number)
                number += 1
            state.assigned[neighbor.edge] = number
            state.text += bond_text(graph, neighbor.edge)
        if number >= 10
            state.text += "%"
        state.text += string(number)
    children := traversal.children[atom_index]
    for: index < int(#children)
        branch := index + 1 < int(#children)
        if branch
            state.text += "("
        state.text += bond_text(graph, children[index].edge)
        write_node(graph, elements, traversal, children[index].atom, &state)
        if branch
            state.text += ")"

class Canonical(string text, int classes)

Canonical smiles(const molecule.Molecule graph, const map<string, molecule.Element> elements)
    ranked := rank_atoms(graph, elements)
    start := 0
    while ranked.values[start] != 1
        start += 1
    traversal := Traversal(array(#graph.atoms, fill = 0), array(#graph.bonds, fill = 0), array(#graph.atoms, fill = []))
    visit(graph, ranked.values, start, -1, &traversal)
    state := Writing(array(#graph.bonds, fill = 0))
    write_node(graph, elements, traversal, start, &state)
    return Canonical(state.text, ranked.classes)

import molecule = "./molecule.qui"
import parser = "./smiles_parser.qui"
import ring_ops = "./rings_aromatic.qui"
import canonical = "./canonical.qui"
import search = "./search.qui"

bool valid_name(string text)
    if #text == 0 or #text > 32
        return false
    for: position < int(#text)
        character := text[position]
        if not ((65 <= character.codepoints()[0] <= 90) or (97 <= character.codepoints()[0] <= 122) or (48 <= character.codepoints()[0] <= 57) or character == "_" or character == "-")
            return false
    return true

int | none number(string text, int low, int high)
    if #text == 0 or (#text > 1 and text[0] == "0")
        return none
    for: position < int(#text)
        if text[position].codepoints()[0] < 48 or text[position].codepoints()[0] > 57
            return none
    value := int(text)
    if low <= value <= high
        return value
    return none

search.Ratio | none parse_threshold(string text)
    words := text.split("/")
    if #words != 2
        return none
    int numerator
    int denominator
    match number(words[0], 0, 99)
        int parsed
            numerator = parsed
        none
            return none
    match number(words[1], 1, 99)
        int parsed
            denominator = parsed
        none
            return none
    if numerator > denominator
        return none
    return search.Ratio(numerator, denominator)

int get_count<K>(const map<K, int> table, K key)
    match table.get(key)
        int value
            return value
        none
            return 0

int[] members_for(const map<string, int[]> groups, string key)
    match groups.get(key)
        int[] members
            return members
        none
            return []

molecule.Molecule | molecule.Problem finish_valences(molecule.Molecule graph, const map<string, molecule.Element> elements)
    for: atom_index < int(#graph.atoms)
        molecule.Atom atom := graph.atoms[atom_index]
        if atom.bracket
            molecule.Element info := molecule.lookup(elements, atom.element)
            if graph.multiplicity(atom_index) + atom.hydrogens > info.valences[-1] + molecule.absolute(atom.charge)
                return molecule.Problem("bad valence", atom.column)
        else
            match graph.organic_hydrogens(atom_index, elements)
                int hydrogens
                    graph.atoms[atom_index].hydrogens = hydrogens
                none
                    return molecule.Problem("bad valence", atom.column)
    return graph

molecule.Molecule | molecule.Problem analyze(string text, const map<string, molecule.Element> elements)
    molecule.Molecule graph
    match parser.parse(text, elements)
        parser.Parsed parsed
            graph = parsed.graph
        molecule.Problem problem
            return problem
    ring_ops.detect(&graph)
    for: edge < int(#graph.bonds)
        molecule.Bond bond := graph.bonds[edge]
        if bond.kind == 0
            graph.bonds[edge].kind = if graph.atoms[bond.first].aromatic and graph.atoms[bond.second].aromatic and bond.ring then 4 else 1
    match ring_ops.kekulize(&graph, elements)
        molecule.Problem problem
            return problem
        none
            return finish_valences(graph, elements)

string | none make_scaffold(const molecule.Molecule graph, const map<string, molecule.Element> elements)
    if #graph.rings == 0
        return none
    ring_atoms := array(#graph.atoms, fill = false)
    for ring := graph.rings[]
        for member := ring[]
            ring_atoms[member] = true
    remaining := array(#graph.atoms, fill = true)
    while true
        removed := -1
        for: atom_index < int(#graph.atoms)
            if not remaining[atom_index] or ring_atoms[atom_index]
                continue
            neighbors := 0
            for neighbor := graph.neighbors[atom_index][]
                if remaining[neighbor.atom]
                    neighbors += 1
            if neighbors == 1
                removed = atom_index
                break
        if removed < 0
            break
        remaining[removed] = false
    core := remaining
    for bond := graph.bonds[]
        if bond.kind == 2
            if core[bond.first]
                remaining[bond.second] = true
            if core[bond.second]
                remaining[bond.first] = true
    scaffold_graph := molecule.Molecule()
    indices := array(#graph.atoms, fill = -1)
    for: atom_index < int(#graph.atoms)
        if not remaining[atom_index]
            continue
        indices[atom_index] = int(#scaffold_graph.atoms)
        extra := 0
        for neighbor := graph.neighbors[atom_index][]
            if not remaining[neighbor.atom]
                extra += graph.bonds[neighbor.edge].multiplicity
        molecule.Atom copied := graph.atoms[atom_index]
        copied.hydrogens += extra
        scaffold_graph.atoms = scaffold_graph.atoms.append(copied)
    for bond := graph.bonds[]
        if remaining[bond.first] and remaining[bond.second]
            molecule.Bond copied := bond
            copied.first = indices[bond.first]
            copied.second = indices[bond.second]
            scaffold_graph.bonds = scaffold_graph.bonds.append(copied)
    molecule.rebuild(&scaffold_graph)
    result := canonical.smiles(scaffold_graph, elements)
    return result.text

class Analysis(string name, molecule.Molecule graph, string smiles, int classes, string formula, int weight, int heavy, int rotatable, int donors, int acceptors, string lipinski, int charge, string | none scaffold_text, search.Fingerprint fingerprint)

Analysis properties(string name, const molecule.Molecule graph, const map<string, molecule.Element> elements)
    map<string, int> counts
    weight := 0
    hydrogens := 0
    charge := 0
    heavy := 0
    donors := 0
    acceptors := 0
    int[] heavy_degree := []
    bool[] triple := []
    for: atom_index < int(#graph.atoms)
        molecule.Atom atom := graph.atoms[atom_index]
        .counts.set(atom.element, get_count(counts, atom.element) + 1)
        hydrogens += atom.hydrogens
        molecule.Element info := molecule.lookup(elements, atom.element)
        weight += if atom.mass == 0 then info.mass else atom.mass * 1000
        charge += atom.charge
        if atom.element != "H"
            heavy += 1
        heavy_neighbors := 0
        triple_bond := false
        attached_hydrogen := atom.hydrogens > 0
        for neighbor := graph.neighbors[atom_index][]
            if graph.atoms[neighbor.atom].element != "H"
                heavy_neighbors += 1
            else
                attached_hydrogen = true
            triple_bond = triple_bond or graph.bonds[neighbor.edge].multiplicity == 3
        heavy_degree = heavy_degree.append(heavy_neighbors)
        triple = triple.append(triple_bond)
        if atom.element == "N" or atom.element == "O"
            acceptors += 1
            if attached_hydrogen
                donors += 1
    .counts.set("H", get_count(counts, "H") + hydrogens)
    molecule.Element hydrogen := molecule.lookup(elements, "H")
    weight += hydrogens * hydrogen.mass
    string[] order := []
    if counts.has("C")
        order = order.append("C")
        if get_count(counts, "H") > 0
            order = order.append("H")
    keys := counts.keys().sorted()
    for key := keys[]
        if get_count(counts, key) > 0 and not molecule.has(order, key)
            order = order.append(key)
    formula := ""
    for key := order[]
        formula += key
        amount := get_count(counts, key)
        if amount > 1
            formula += string(amount)
    rotatable := 0
    for bond := graph.bonds[]
        if bond.multiplicity == 1 and not bond.ring and heavy_degree[bond.first] >= 2 and heavy_degree[bond.second] >= 2 and not triple[bond.first] and not triple[bond.second]
            rotatable += 1
    violations := (if weight > 500000 then 1 else 0) + (if donors > 5 then 1 else 0) + (if acceptors > 10 then 1 else 0)
    encoded := canonical.smiles(graph, elements)
    lipinski := if violations <= 1 then "pass" else "fail"
    string | none scaffold_text := make_scaffold(graph, elements)
    fingerprint := search.fingerprint(graph, elements)
    return Analysis(name, graph, encoded.text, encoded.classes, formula, weight, heavy, rotatable, donors, acceptors, lipinski, charge, scaffold_text, fingerprint)

class RingSystem(int[] members, string kind, int atom_count)

RingSystem[] ring_systems(const molecule.Molecule graph)
    remaining := array(#graph.rings, fill = true)
    RingSystem[] result := []
    for: start < int(#graph.rings)
        if not remaining[start]
            continue
        pending := [start]
        remaining[start] = false
        int[] group := []
        while #pending != 0
            last := int(#pending) - 1
            current := pending[last]
            pending = pending[0:<last]
            group = group.append(current)
            for: candidate < int(#graph.rings)
                if not remaining[candidate]
                    continue
                connected := false
                for atom_index := graph.rings[current][]
                    if molecule.has(graph.rings[candidate], atom_index)
                        connected = true
                        break
                if connected
                    remaining[candidate] = false
                    pending = pending.append(candidate)
        ordered := group.sorted()
        kind := if #ordered == 1 then "isolated" else "spiro"
        atoms := array(#graph.atoms, fill = false)
        for member := ordered[]
            for atom_index := graph.rings[member][]
                atoms[atom_index] = true
        for: first < int(#ordered)
            for: first + 1 <= second < int(#ordered)
                int[] common := []
                for atom_index := graph.rings[ordered[first]][]
                    if molecule.has(graph.rings[ordered[second]], atom_index)
                        common = common.append(atom_index)
                if #common >= 2
                    if #common == 2 and molecule.has_bond(graph, common[0], common[1])
                        if kind != "bridged"
                            kind = "fused"
                    else
                        kind = "bridged"
        atom_count := 0
        for included := atoms[]
            if included
                atom_count += 1
        result = result.append(RingSystem(ordered, kind, atom_count))
    return result

void paragraph(string[] &output, const string[] lines)
    if #output > 0
        output = output.append("")
    output = output.concat(lines)

string atom_numbers(const int[] values, separator := ",")
    string[] words := []
    for value := values[]
        words = words.append(string(value + 1))
    return words.join(separator)

string molecule_names(const Analysis[] molecules, const int[] indices)
    string[] names := []
    for index := indices[]
        names = names.append(molecules[index].name)
    return names.join(",")

string mapping_text(const int[] values)
    string[] words := []
    for value := values[]
        words = words.append(string(value))
    return words.join(",")

string[] canonical_report(const Analysis[] molecules)
    map<string, int[]> smiles_groups
    map<string, int[]> formula_groups
    map<string, int[]> scaffold_groups
    acyclic := 0
    string[] canonical_lines := []
    for: index < int(#molecules)
        current := molecules[index]
        .smiles_groups.set(current.smiles, members_for(smiles_groups, current.smiles).append(index))
        .formula_groups.set(current.formula, members_for(formula_groups, current.formula).append(index))
        match current.scaffold_text
            string scaffold_key
                .scaffold_groups.set(scaffold_key, members_for(scaffold_groups, scaffold_key).append(index))
            none
                acyclic += 1
        sign := if current.charge > 0 then "+" else ""
        canonical_lines = canonical_lines.append("{current.name} {current.smiles} classes={current.classes} charge={sign}{current.charge}")
    string[] result := []
    paragraph(&result, ["CANONICAL molecules={#molecules} unique={smiles_groups.size()}"].concat(canonical_lines))
    smiles_keys := smiles_groups.keys()
    string[] duplicate_lines := []
    duplicate_count := 0
    duplicate_molecules := 0
    for key := smiles_keys[]
        members := members_for(smiles_groups, key)
        if #members >= 2
            duplicate_count += 1
            duplicate_molecules += int(#members)
            duplicate_lines = duplicate_lines.append("group {duplicate_count} {key} members={molecule_names(molecules, members)}")
    paragraph(&result, ["DUPLICATES groups={duplicate_count} molecules={duplicate_molecules}"].concat(duplicate_lines))
    formula_keys := formula_groups.keys()
    string[] isomer_lines := []
    isomer_count := 0
    for key := formula_keys[]
        members := members_for(formula_groups, key)
        distinct<string> forms
        for index := members[]
            .forms.add(molecules[index].smiles)
        if forms.size() >= 2
            isomer_count += 1
            isomer_lines = isomer_lines.append("isomer {isomer_count} {key} forms={forms.size()} members={molecule_names(molecules, members)}")
    paragraph(&result, ["ISOMERS groups={isomer_count}"].concat(isomer_lines))
    scaffold_keys := scaffold_groups.keys().sorted()
    for: position < int(#scaffold_keys)
        current_position := position
        while current_position > 0
            first_key := scaffold_keys[current_position]
            previous_key := scaffold_keys[current_position - 1]
            if #members_for(scaffold_groups, first_key) <= #members_for(scaffold_groups, previous_key)
                break
            scaffold_keys[current_position] = previous_key
            scaffold_keys[current_position - 1] = first_key
            current_position -= 1
    scaffold_lines := ["SCAFFOLDS distinct={#scaffold_keys} acyclic={acyclic}"]
    for: position < int(#scaffold_keys)
        key := scaffold_keys[position]
        members := members_for(scaffold_groups, key)
        scaffold_lines = scaffold_lines.append("scaffold {position + 1} {key} count={#members} members={molecule_names(molecules, members)}")
    paragraph(&result, scaffold_lines)
    return result

string[] rings_report(const Analysis[] molecules)
    string[] result := []
    total := 0
    aromatic := 0
    cyclic := 0
    map<int, int> sizes
    kinds := ["isolated", "fused", "spiro", "bridged"]
    kind_counts := [0, 0, 0, 0]
    for current := molecules[]
        graph := current.graph
        if #graph.rings == 0
            continue
        aromatic_count := 0
        ring_atoms := array(#graph.atoms, fill = false)
        for ring := graph.rings[]
            all_aromatic := true
            for atom_index := ring[]
                all_aromatic = all_aromatic and graph.atoms[atom_index].aromatic
                ring_atoms[atom_index] = true
            if all_aromatic
                aromatic_count += 1
        systems := ring_systems(graph)
        cyclic += 1
        total += int(#graph.rings)
        aromatic += aromatic_count
        ring_atom_count := 0
        ring_bond_count := 0
        for included := ring_atoms[]
            if included
                ring_atom_count += 1
        for bond := graph.bonds[]
            if bond.ring
                ring_bond_count += 1
        lines := ["MOLECULE {current.name} atoms={#graph.atoms} bonds={#graph.bonds} rings={#graph.rings} aromatic={aromatic_count} systems={#systems} ring_atoms={ring_atom_count} ring_bonds={ring_bond_count}"]
        for: index < int(#graph.rings)
            ring := graph.rings[index]
            size := int(#ring)
            .sizes.set(size, get_count(sizes, size) + 1)
            all_aromatic := true
            hetero := 0
            for atom_index := ring[]
                all_aromatic = all_aromatic and graph.atoms[atom_index].aromatic
                if graph.atoms[atom_index].element != "C"
                    hetero += 1
            aromatic_text := if all_aromatic then "yes" else "no"
            atom_sequence := atom_numbers(ring, "-")
            lines = lines.append("ring {index + 1} size={size} aromatic={aromatic_text} hetero={hetero} atoms={atom_sequence}")
        for: index < int(#systems)
            system := systems[index]
            for: kind_index < int(#kinds)
                if kinds[kind_index] == system.kind
                    kind_counts[kind_index] += 1
                    break
            lines = lines.append("system {index + 1} kind={system.kind} rings={atom_numbers(system.members)} atoms={system.atom_count}")
        string[] doubles := []
        for bond := graph.bonds[]
            if bond.kind == 4 and bond.multiplicity == 2
                doubles = doubles.append("{bond.first + 1}={bond.second + 1}")
        double_text := if #doubles == 0 then "-" else doubles.join(" ")
        lines = lines.append("kekule {double_text}")
        paragraph(&result, lines)
    size_keys := sizes.keys().sorted()
    string[] size_parts := []
    for size := size_keys[]
        size_parts = size_parts.append("{size}={get_count(sizes, size)}")
    size_text := if #size_parts == 0 then "-" else size_parts.join(" ")
    paragraph(&result, ["SUMMARY molecules={#molecules} cyclic={cyclic} rings={total} aromatic={aromatic}", "sizes {size_text}", "systems isolated={kind_counts[0]} fused={kind_counts[1]} spiro={kind_counts[2]} bridged={kind_counts[3]}"])
    return result

class Query(string kind, string identifier, string[] arguments)
    int[] indices := []
    search.Pattern | none pattern := none
    count := 0
    threshold := search.Ratio(0, 1)

int | error molecule_index(const map<string, int> names, string name)
    match names.get(name)
        int found
            return found
        none
            return error("unknown molecule {name}")

Query | error query(const string[] words, const map<string, int> names, const map<string, molecule.Element> elements)
    kind := words[0]
    arguments := words[2:<int(#words)]
    argument_count := int(#arguments)
    valid := if kind == "MATCH" or kind == "CLUSTER" then argument_count == 1 elif kind == "MATRIX" then 2 <= argument_count <= 12 else argument_count == 2
    if not valid
        return error("bad arguments")
    result := Query(kind, words[1], arguments)
    if kind == "MATCH"
        match parser.parse(arguments[0], elements, true)
            parser.Parsed parsed
                result.pattern = search.Pattern(parsed.graph, parsed.matchers)
            molecule.Problem problem
                return error("bad pattern {problem.reason} at column {problem.column}")
    elif kind == "CLUSTER"
        match parse_threshold(arguments[0])
            search.Ratio ratio
                result.threshold = ratio
            none
                return error("bad threshold")
    elif kind == "NEAREST" or kind == "WITHIN"
        found := try molecule_index(names, arguments[0])
        result.indices = [found]
        if kind == "NEAREST"
            match number(arguments[1], 1, 99)
                int count
                    result.count = count
                none
                    return error("bad count")
        else
            match parse_threshold(arguments[1])
                search.Ratio ratio
                    result.threshold = ratio
                none
                    return error("bad threshold")
    else
        for name := arguments[]
            found := try molecule_index(names, name)
            result.indices = result.indices.append(found)
        distinct<int> unique_indices
        for index := result.indices[]
            .unique_indices.add(index)
        if unique_indices.size() != #result.indices
            return error("repeated molecule")
    return result

search.Ratio pair_similarity(const Analysis[] molecules, int first, int second)
    return search.similarity(molecules[first].fingerprint, molecules[second].fingerprint)

search.Pattern | error required_pattern(search.Pattern | none value)
    match value
        search.Pattern found
            return found
        none
            return error("missing MATCH pattern")

class Hit(int index, search.Matches matches)
class Similar(int index, search.Ratio ratio)

void process_query(const Query current_query, const Analysis[] molecules, string[] &substructure, string[] &similarity, int[] &counts)
    kind := current_query.kind
    identifier := current_query.identifier
    arguments := current_query.arguments
    if kind == "MATCH"
        counts[0] += 1
        pattern := required_pattern(current_query.pattern)
        Hit[] hits := []
        embeddings := 0
        top_index := -1
        top_count := -1
        for: index < int(#molecules)
            found := search.embeddings(pattern, molecules[index].graph)
            if found.count > 0
                hits = hits.append(Hit(index, found))
                embeddings += found.count
                if found.count > top_count
                    top_index = index
                    top_count = found.count
        counts[1] += int(#hits)
        lines := ["MATCH {identifier} {arguments[0]} atoms={#pattern.graph.atoms} bonds={#pattern.graph.bonds} hits={#hits} embeddings={embeddings}"]
        for hit := hits[]
            lines = lines.append("{molecules[hit.index].name} count={hit.matches.count} unique={hit.matches.unique_count} map={mapping_text(hit.matches.first_mapping)}")
        if top_index >= 0
            lines = lines.append("top {molecules[top_index].name} count={top_count}")
        paragraph(&substructure, lines)
    elif kind == "CONTAINS"
        counts[2] += 1
        pattern := search.molecule_pattern(molecules[current_query.indices[0]].graph)
        found := search.embeddings(pattern, molecules[current_query.indices[1]].graph)
        verdict := "no"
        if found.count > 0
            counts[3] += 1
            verdict = "yes count={found.count} unique={found.unique_count} map={mapping_text(found.first_mapping)}"
        paragraph(&substructure, ["CONTAINS {identifier} {arguments[0]} {arguments[1]} result={verdict}"])
    elif kind == "MATRIX"
        indices := current_query.indices
        lines := ["MATRIX {identifier} size={#indices}"]
        for index := indices[]
            string[] entries := []
            for other := indices[]
                ratio := pair_similarity(molecules, index, other)
                entries = entries.append(ratio.text())
            joined_entries := entries.join(" ")
            lines = lines.append("row {molecules[index].name} {joined_entries}")
        best_first := 0
        best_second := 1
        best := pair_similarity(molecules, indices[0], indices[1])
        for: first < int(#indices)
            for: first + 1 <= second < int(#indices)
                ratio := pair_similarity(molecules, indices[first], indices[second])
                if ratio.compare(best) > 0
                    best_first = first
                    best_second = second
                    best = ratio
        lines = lines.append("best {arguments[best_first]} {arguments[best_second]} {best.text()}")
        paragraph(&similarity, lines)
    elif kind == "NEAREST" or kind == "WITHIN"
        selected := current_query.indices[0]
        Similar[] ordered := []
        for: index < int(#molecules)
            if index != selected
                ordered = ordered.append(Similar(index, pair_similarity(molecules, selected, index)))
        for: position < int(#ordered)
            current_position := position
            while current_position > 0 and ordered[current_position].ratio.compare(ordered[current_position - 1].ratio) > 0
                saved := ordered[current_position]
                ordered[current_position] = ordered[current_position - 1]
                ordered[current_position - 1] = saved
                current_position -= 1
        Similar[] chosen := []
        for candidate := ordered[]
            if kind == "NEAREST"
                if int(#chosen) == current_query.count
                    break
                chosen = chosen.append(candidate)
            elif candidate.ratio.compare(current_query.threshold) >= 0
                chosen = chosen.append(candidate)
        heading := if kind == "NEAREST" then "NEAREST {identifier} {arguments[0]} count={#chosen}" else "WITHIN {identifier} {arguments[0]} threshold={current_query.threshold.text()} count={#chosen}"
        lines := [heading]
        for: position < int(#chosen)
            candidate := chosen[position]
            lines = lines.append("{position + 1} {molecules[candidate.index].name} {candidate.ratio.text()} common={candidate.ratio.numerator}")
        paragraph(&similarity, lines)
    elif kind == "COMPARE"
        first := molecules[current_query.indices[0]]
        second := molecules[current_query.indices[1]]
        ratio := search.similarity(first.fingerprint, second.fingerprint)
        identical := if first.smiles == second.smiles then "yes" else "no"
        paragraph(&similarity, ["COMPARE {identifier} {arguments[0]} {arguments[1]} bits={first.fingerprint.bits.size()},{second.fingerprint.bits.size()} common={ratio.numerator} union={ratio.denominator} tanimoto={ratio.text()} identical={identical}"])
    else
        int[][] neighbors := array(#molecules, fill = [])
        for: index < int(#molecules)
            for: other < int(#molecules)
                if index != other
                    ratio := pair_similarity(molecules, index, other)
                    if ratio.compare(current_query.threshold) >= 0
                        neighbors[index] = neighbors[index].append(other)
        int[] order := []
        for: index < int(#molecules)
            order = order.append(index)
        for: position < int(#order)
            current_position := position
            while current_position > 0 and #neighbors[order[current_position]] > #neighbors[order[current_position - 1]]
                saved := order[current_position]
                order[current_position] = order[current_position - 1]
                order[current_position - 1] = saved
                current_position -= 1
        used := array(#molecules, fill = false)
        int[][] clusters := []
        singletons := 0
        for center := order[]
            if used[center]
                continue
            used[center] = true
            members := [center]
            for neighbor := neighbors[center][]
                if not used[neighbor]
                    used[neighbor] = true
                    members = members.append(neighbor)
            clusters = clusters.append(members)
            if #members == 1
                singletons += 1
        lines := ["CLUSTER {identifier} threshold={current_query.threshold.text()} clusters={#clusters} singletons={singletons}"]
        serial := 0
        for members := clusters[]
            if #members > 1
                serial += 1
                lines = lines.append("cluster {serial} centroid={molecules[members[0]].name} size={#members} members={molecule_names(molecules, members)}")
        paragraph(&similarity, lines)

void record_cause(map<string, int> &causes, string reason)
    .causes.set(reason, get_count(causes, reason) + 1)

string weight_text(int weight)
    whole := weight / 1000
    remainder := weight % 1000
    tail := string(remainder)
    if #tail < 3
        tail = "0" * nat(3 - int(#tail)) + tail
    return "{whole}.{tail}"

void write(string name, const string[] lines)
    bool present := file.is_directory("output")
    if not present
        file.mkdir("output")
    string text := if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(text)

void run_program()
    map<string, molecule.Element> elements := molecule.read_elements()
    Analysis[] molecules := []
    distinct<string> seen
    string[] molecule_errors := []
    map<string, int> causes
    molecule_lines := 0
    string molecule_text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/molecules.smi"))
    molecule_source := molecule_text.split(NL)
    for: index < int(#molecule_source)
        line := molecule_source[index]
        if line == "" or line.starts_with("#")
            continue
        molecule_lines += 1
        words := line.split(" ")
        if #words != 2 or words[0] == "" or not valid_name(words[1])
            molecule_errors = molecule_errors.append("line {index + 1}: bad line")
            record_cause(&causes, "bad line")
        elif seen.has(words[1])
            molecule_errors = molecule_errors.append("line {index + 1} {words[1]}: duplicate name")
            record_cause(&causes, "duplicate name")
        else
            .seen.add(words[1])
            match analyze(words[0], elements)
                molecule.Molecule graph
                    molecules = molecules.append(properties(words[1], graph, elements))
                molecule.Problem problem
                    molecule_errors = molecule_errors.append("line {index + 1} {words[1]}: {problem.reason} at column {problem.column}")
                    record_cause(&causes, problem.reason)
    map<string, int> names
    property_lines := ["name,formula,weight,heavy_atoms,rings,rotatable,donors,acceptors,lipinski"]
    similarity := ["FINGERPRINTS molecules={#molecules} size=1024 depth=5"]
    for: index < int(#molecules)
        current := molecules[index]
        .names.set(current.name, index)
        property_lines = property_lines.append("{current.name},{current.formula},{weight_text(current.weight)},{current.heavy},{#current.graph.rings},{current.rotatable},{current.donors},{current.acceptors},{current.lipinski}")
        similarity = similarity.append("{current.name} bits={current.fingerprint.bits.size()} paths={current.fingerprint.paths}")
    string[] substructure := []
    distinct<string> identifiers
    string[] query_errors := []
    query_lines := 0
    query_valid := 0
    counts := [0, 0, 0, 0]
    string query_text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/queries.txt"))
    query_source := query_text.split(NL)
    query_kinds := ["MATCH", "CONTAINS", "MATRIX", "NEAREST", "WITHIN", "COMPARE", "CLUSTER"]
    for: index < int(#query_source)
        line := query_source[index]
        if line == "" or line.starts_with("#")
            continue
        query_lines += 1
        words := line.split(" ")
        if not molecule.has(query_kinds, words[0])
            query_errors = query_errors.append("line {index + 1}: unknown query")
            record_cause(&causes, "unknown query")
        elif #words == 1 or not valid_name(words[1])
            query_errors = query_errors.append("line {index + 1} {words[0]}: bad id")
            record_cause(&causes, "bad id")
        elif identifiers.has(words[1])
            query_errors = query_errors.append("line {index + 1} {words[0]} {words[1]}: duplicate id")
            record_cause(&causes, "duplicate id")
        else
            .identifiers.add(words[1])
            match query(words, names, elements)
                Query accepted
                    query_valid += 1
                    process_query(accepted, molecules, &substructure, &similarity, &counts)
                error rejected
                    string reason := rejected.message
                    query_errors = query_errors.append("line {index + 1} {words[0]} {words[1]}: {reason}")
                    cause := reason
                    if reason.starts_with("bad pattern ")
                        cause = "bad pattern"
                    elif reason.starts_with("unknown molecule ")
                        cause = "unknown molecule"
                    record_cause(&causes, cause)
    paragraph(&substructure, ["SUMMARY patterns={counts[0]} hits={counts[1]} contains={counts[2]} found={counts[3]}"])
    string[] errors := []
    paragraph(&errors, ["MOLECULES lines={molecule_lines} valid={#molecules} errors={#molecule_errors}"].concat(molecule_errors))
    paragraph(&errors, ["QUERIES lines={query_lines} valid={query_valid} errors={#query_errors}"].concat(query_errors))
    cause_keys := causes.keys().sorted()
    for: position < int(#cause_keys)
        current_position := position
        while current_position > 0 and get_count(causes, cause_keys[current_position]) > get_count(causes, cause_keys[current_position - 1])
            saved := cause_keys[current_position]
            cause_keys[current_position] = cause_keys[current_position - 1]
            cause_keys[current_position - 1] = saved
            current_position -= 1
    cause_lines := ["CAUSES kinds={causes.size()}"]
    for key := cause_keys[]
        cause_lines = cause_lines.append("{key}={get_count(causes, key)}")
    paragraph(&errors, cause_lines)
    write("properties.csv", property_lines)
    write("canonical.txt", canonical_report(molecules))
    write("rings.txt", rings_report(molecules))
    write("substructure.txt", substructure)
    write("similarity.txt", similarity)
    write("errors.txt", errors)

if main
    run_program()

class Element(int number, int mass, int[] valences)
class Atom(string element, aromatic := false, mass := 0, charge := 0, hydrogens := 0, bracket := false, column := 1)
class Bond(int first, int second, int kind, multiplicity := 0, ring := false)
class Neighbor(int atom, int edge)
class Problem(string reason, int column)

bool has<T>(const T[] values, T sought)
    for value := values[]
        if value == sought
            return true
    return false

int compare(const int[] first, const int[] second)
    count := if #first < #second then int(#first) else int(#second)
    for: position < count
        if first[position] < second[position]
            return -1
        if first[position] > second[position]
            return 1
    return if #first < #second then -1 elif #first > #second then 1 else 0

int absolute(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -value else value

Element | error lookup(const map<string, Element> table, string symbol)
    match table.get(symbol)
        Element found
            return found
        none
            return error("unknown element")

map<string, Element> read_elements()
    map<string, Element> table
    string text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/elements.txt"))
    lines := text.split(NL)
    for line := lines[]
        if line == "" or line.starts_with("#")
            continue
        words := line.split(" ")
        int[] valences := []
        numbers := words[3].split(",")
        for number := numbers[]
            parsed := int(number)
            valences = valences.append(parsed)
        atomic_number := int(words[1])
        mass := int(words[2])
        .table.set(words[0], Element(atomic_number, mass, valences))
    return table

class Molecule()
    Atom[] atoms := []
    Bond[] bonds := []
    Neighbor[][] neighbors := []
    int[][] rings := []

    int | none bond(int first_atom, int second_atom)
        for neighbor := neighbors[first_atom][]
            if neighbor.atom == second_atom
                return neighbor.edge
        return none

    int base(int atom_index)
        total := 0
        for neighbor := neighbors[atom_index][]
            bond_kind := bonds[neighbor.edge].kind
            total += if bond_kind == 4 then 1 else bond_kind
        return total

    int multiplicity(int atom_index)
        total := 0
        for neighbor := neighbors[atom_index][]
            total += bonds[neighbor.edge].multiplicity
        return total

    bool needs_pi(int atom_index, const map<string, Element> elements, bool include_hydrogens)
        current := atoms[atom_index]
        info := lookup(elements, current.element)
        supplied := if include_hydrogens then current.hydrogens else 0
        return current.aromatic and info.valences[0] + current.charge >= base(atom_index) + supplied + 1

    int | none organic_hydrogens(int atom_index, const map<string, Element> elements)
        int total := multiplicity(atom_index)
        info := lookup(elements, atoms[atom_index].element)
        for valence := info.valences[]
            if valence >= total
                return valence - total
        return none

void rebuild(Molecule &graph)
    ordered := graph.bonds
    for: position < int(#ordered)
        current := position
        while current > 0
            left := ordered[current]
            right := ordered[current - 1]
            if not (left.first < right.first or (left.first == right.first and left.second < right.second))
                break
            ordered[current] = right
            ordered[current - 1] = left
            current -= 1
    graph.bonds = ordered
    graph.neighbors = array(#graph.atoms, fill = [])
    for: edge < int(#graph.bonds)
        current_bond := graph.bonds[edge]
        graph.neighbors[current_bond.first] = graph.neighbors[current_bond.first].append(Neighbor(current_bond.second, edge))
        graph.neighbors[current_bond.second] = graph.neighbors[current_bond.second].append(Neighbor(current_bond.first, edge))
    for: atom_index < int(#graph.atoms)
        adjacency := graph.neighbors[atom_index]
        for: position < int(#adjacency)
            current := position
            while current > 0 and adjacency[current].atom < adjacency[current - 1].atom
                saved := adjacency[current]
                adjacency[current] = adjacency[current - 1]
                adjacency[current - 1] = saved
                current -= 1
        graph.neighbors[atom_index] = adjacency

int | error required_bond(const Molecule graph, int first_atom, int second_atom)
    match graph.bond(first_atom, second_atom)
        int found
            return found
        none
            return error("missing ring bond")

bool has_bond(const Molecule graph, int first_atom, int second_atom)
    match graph.bond(first_atom, second_atom)
        int found
            return true
        none
            return false

import molecule = "./molecule.qui"

bool[] edge_set(const molecule.Molecule graph, const int[] ring)
    result := array(#graph.bonds, fill = false)
    for: index < int(#ring)
        edge := molecule.required_bond(graph, ring[index], ring[(index + 1) % int(#ring)])
        result[edge] = true
    return result

int[] path(int atom_index, const int[] parents)
    result := [atom_index]
    current := atom_index
    while parents[current] >= 0
        current = parents[current]
        result = result.append(current)
    return result

class Candidate(int[] atoms, bool[] edges)

void detect(molecule.Molecule &graph)
    atom_count := int(#graph.atoms)
    Candidate[] candidates := []
    bool[][] seen := []
    for: root < atom_count
        parents := array(nat(atom_count), fill = -1)
        visited := array(nat(atom_count), fill = false)
        queue := [root]
        visited[root] = true
        head := 0
        while head < int(#queue)
            current_atom := queue[head]
            head += 1
            for neighbor := graph.neighbors[current_atom][]
                if not visited[neighbor.atom]
                    visited[neighbor.atom] = true
                    parents[neighbor.atom] = current_atom
                    queue = queue.append(neighbor.atom)
        for bond := graph.bonds[]
            if parents[bond.first] == bond.second or parents[bond.second] == bond.first
                continue
            first_path := path(bond.first, parents)
            second_path := path(bond.second, parents)
            shared := false
            for member := first_path[]
                if member != root and molecule.has(second_path, member)
                    shared = true
                    break
            if shared
                continue
            int[] ring := first_path[::-1].concat(second_path[0:<int(#second_path) - 1])
            edges := edge_set(graph, ring)
            if not molecule.has(seen, edges)
                seen = seen.append(edges)
                candidates = candidates.append(Candidate(ring, edges))
    for: position < int(#candidates)
        current := position
        while current > 0 and #candidates[current].atoms < #candidates[current - 1].atoms
            saved := candidates[current]
            candidates[current] = candidates[current - 1]
            candidates[current - 1] = saved
            current -= 1
    bool[][] basis := array(#graph.bonds, fill = [])
    int[][] selected := []
    for candidate := candidates[]
        vector := candidate.edges
        while true
            pivot := int(#vector) - 1
            while pivot >= 0
                if vector[pivot]
                    break
                pivot -= 1
            if pivot < 0
                break
            if #basis[pivot] == 0
                basis[pivot] = vector
                selected = selected.append(candidate.atoms)
                break
            for: edge < int(#vector)
                vector[edge] = vector[edge] != basis[pivot][edge]
    graph.rings = []
    for source := selected[]
        sorted_atoms := source.sorted()
        first_position := 0
        for: index < int(#source)
            if source[index] == sorted_atoms[0]
                first_position = index
                break
        int[] rotated := []
        for: offset < int(#source)
            rotated = rotated.append(source[(first_position + offset) % int(#source)])
        if rotated[1] > rotated[-1]
            backwards := rotated[1:<int(#rotated)][::-1]
            rotated = [rotated[0]].concat(backwards)
        graph.rings = graph.rings.append(rotated)
    for: position < int(#graph.rings)
        current := position
        while current > 0
            first_ring := graph.rings[current]
            second_ring := graph.rings[current - 1]
            precedes := #first_ring < #second_ring or (#first_ring == #second_ring and molecule.compare(first_ring, second_ring) < 0)
            if not precedes
                break
            graph.rings[current] = second_ring
            graph.rings[current - 1] = first_ring
            current -= 1
    for ring := graph.rings[]
        ring_edges := edge_set(graph, ring)
        for: edge < int(#ring_edges)
            if ring_edges[edge]
                graph.bonds[edge].ring = true

bool matching(const molecule.Molecule graph, const bool[] system, int[] &paired)
    first := -1
    for: atom_index < int(#system)
        if system[atom_index] and paired[atom_index] < 0
            first = atom_index
            break
    if first < 0
        return true
    for neighbor := graph.neighbors[first][]
        int second := neighbor.atom
        if system[second] and paired[second] < 0 and graph.bonds[neighbor.edge].kind == 4
            paired[first] = second
            paired[second] = first
            if matching(graph, system, &paired)
                return true
            paired[first] = -1
            paired[second] = -1
    return false

molecule.Problem | none kekulize(molecule.Molecule &graph, const map<string, molecule.Element> elements)
    remaining := array(#graph.atoms, fill = false)
    for: atom_index < int(#graph.atoms)
        remaining[atom_index] = graph.needs_pi(atom_index, elements, true)
    paired := array(#graph.atoms, fill = -1)
    for: start < int(#graph.atoms)
        if not remaining[start]
            continue
        system := array(#graph.atoms, fill = false)
        pending := [start]
        remaining[start] = false
        while #pending != 0
            last := int(#pending) - 1
            current_atom := pending[last]
            pending = pending[0:<last]
            system[current_atom] = true
            for neighbor := graph.neighbors[current_atom][]
                if graph.bonds[neighbor.edge].kind == 4 and remaining[neighbor.atom]
                    remaining[neighbor.atom] = false
                    pending = pending.append(neighbor.atom)
        if not matching(graph, system, &paired)
            return molecule.Problem("kekulization failed", graph.atoms[start].column)
    for: edge < int(#graph.bonds)
        molecule.Bond original := graph.bonds[edge]
        graph.bonds[edge].multiplicity = if original.kind == 4 then (if paired[original.first] == original.second then 2 else 1) else original.kind
    return none

import molecule = "./molecule.qui"

class AtomChoice(string element, bool aromatic)
class Matcher(int kind, AtomChoice[] choices := [])
class Pattern(molecule.Molecule graph, Matcher[] atoms)
class PatternAtom(Matcher matcher, int consumed)
class Organic(string element, bool aromatic, int consumed)
class Matches(int count, int unique_count, int[] first_mapping)

Organic | none organic(string text)
    if text.starts_with("Cl")
        return Organic("Cl", false, 2)
    if text.starts_with("Br")
        return Organic("Br", false, 2)
    if #text == 0
        return none
    character := text[0]
    if "BCNOPSFI".contains(character)
        return Organic(character, false, 1)
    lowercase := "bcnops"
    uppercase := "BCNOPS"
    for: position < 6
        if character == lowercase[position]
            return Organic(uppercase[position], true, 1)
    return none

PatternAtom | molecule.Problem pattern_atom(string text, int column)
    character := text[0]
    if character == "*"
        return PatternAtom(Matcher(0), 1)
    if character == "A"
        return PatternAtom(Matcher(1), 1)
    if character == "a"
        return PatternAtom(Matcher(2), 1)
    if character == "["
        int end_position
        match text.find("]")
            nat found
                end_position = int(found)
            none
                return molecule.Problem("unclosed bracket", column)
        content := text[1:<end_position]
        parts := content.split(",")
        AtomChoice[] choices := []
        for part := parts[]
            match organic(part)
                Organic value
                    if value.consumed != int(#part)
                        return molecule.Problem("bad bracket atom", column)
                    choices = choices.append(AtomChoice(value.element, value.aromatic))
                none
                    return molecule.Problem("bad bracket atom", column)
        return PatternAtom(Matcher(3, choices), end_position + 1)
    match organic(text)
        Organic value
            return PatternAtom(Matcher(3, [AtomChoice(value.element, value.aromatic)]), value.consumed)
        none
            return molecule.Problem("unexpected character", column)

Pattern molecule_pattern(const molecule.Molecule graph)
    Matcher[] atoms := []
    for atom := graph.atoms[]
        atoms = atoms.append(Matcher(3, [AtomChoice(atom.element, atom.aromatic)]))
    return Pattern(graph, atoms)

bool atom_matches(Matcher matcher, molecule.Atom atom)
    if matcher.kind == 0
        return true
    if matcher.kind == 1
        return not atom.aromatic
    if matcher.kind == 2
        return atom.aromatic
    for choice := matcher.choices[]
        if choice.element == atom.element and choice.aromatic == atom.aromatic
            return true
    return false

class SearchState(bool[] used)
    int[] mapping := []
    unique_sets := distinct<string>()
    count := 0
    int[] first_mapping := []

void visit(const Pattern pattern, const molecule.Molecule graph, SearchState &state)
    pattern_atom_index := int(#state.mapping)
    if pattern_atom_index == int(#pattern.atoms)
        state.count += 1
        if #state.first_mapping == 0
            for mapped := state.mapping[]
                state.first_mapping = state.first_mapping.append(mapped + 1)
        ordered := state.mapping.sorted()
        string[] words := []
        for value := ordered[]
            words = words.append(string(value))
        .state.unique_sets.add(words.join(","))
        return
    for: candidate < int(#graph.atoms)
        if state.used[candidate] or not atom_matches(pattern.atoms[pattern_atom_index], graph.atoms[candidate])
            continue
        compatible := true
        for neighbor := pattern.graph.neighbors[pattern_atom_index][]
            if neighbor.atom >= pattern_atom_index
                continue
            int matching_edge
            match graph.bond(candidate, state.mapping[neighbor.atom])
                int found
                    matching_edge = found
                none
                    compatible = false
                    break
            int expected := pattern.graph.bonds[neighbor.edge].kind
            int actual := graph.bonds[matching_edge].kind
            if not ((expected == 0 and (actual == 1 or actual == 4)) or expected == 5 or expected == actual)
                compatible = false
                break
        if compatible
            state.used[candidate] = true
            state.mapping = state.mapping.append(candidate)
            visit(pattern, graph, &state)
            state.mapping = state.mapping[0:<int(#state.mapping) - 1]
            state.used[candidate] = false

Matches embeddings(const Pattern pattern, const molecule.Molecule graph)
    state := SearchState(array(#graph.atoms, fill = false))
    visit(pattern, graph, &state)
    return Matches(state.count, int(state.unique_sets.size()), state.first_mapping)

class Fingerprint()
    bits := distinct<int>()
    paths := 0

void walk(const molecule.Molecule graph, const int[] codes, const int[] atom_path, int hash, Fingerprint &result)
    result.paths += 1
    .result.bits.add(hash % 1024)
    if #atom_path == 6
        return
    current := atom_path[-1]
    for neighbor := graph.neighbors[current][]
        if not molecule.has(atom_path, neighbor.atom)
            int updated := ((hash * 31 + graph.bonds[neighbor.edge].kind) % 1000003 * 31 + codes[neighbor.atom]) % 1000003
            walk(graph, codes, atom_path.append(neighbor.atom), updated, &result)

Fingerprint fingerprint(const molecule.Molecule graph, const map<string, molecule.Element> elements)
    int[] codes := []
    for: index < int(#graph.atoms)
        molecule.Atom atom := graph.atoms[index]
        molecule.Element info := molecule.lookup(elements, atom.element)
        codes = codes.append(16 * info.number + (if atom.aromatic then 8 else 0) + int(#graph.neighbors[index]))
    result := Fingerprint()
    for: index < int(#graph.atoms)
        walk(graph, codes, [index], codes[index], &result)
    return result

class Ratio(int numerator, int denominator)
    int compare(Ratio other)
        first_product := numerator * other.denominator
        second_product := other.numerator * denominator
        return if first_product < second_product then -1 elif first_product > second_product then 1 else 0

    string text()
        left := numerator
        right := denominator
        while right != 0
            left, right = right, left % right
        reduced_numerator := numerator / left
        reduced_denominator := denominator / left
        return "{reduced_numerator}/{reduced_denominator}"

Ratio similarity(const Fingerprint first, const Fingerprint second)
    common := 0
    values := first.bits.values()
    for value := values[]
        if second.bits.has(value)
            common += 1
    return Ratio(common, int(first.bits.size()) + int(second.bits.size()) - common)

import molecule = "./molecule.qui"
import search = "./search.qui"

class Parsed(molecule.Molecule graph, search.Matcher[] matchers)
class ParsedAtom(molecule.Atom atom, int consumed)
class Branch(int atom, int column)
class OpenRing(open := false, atom := -1, bond_kind := -1, column := 0)

bool digit(string character)
    return 48 <= character.codepoints()[0] <= 57

search.Organic | none organic(string text)
    if text.starts_with("Cl")
        return search.Organic("Cl", false, 2)
    if text.starts_with("Br")
        return search.Organic("Br", false, 2)
    if #text == 0
        return none
    character := text[0]
    if "BCNOPSFI".contains(character)
        return search.Organic(character, false, 1)
    lowercase := "bcnops"
    uppercase := "BCNOPS"
    for: position < 6
        if character == lowercase[position]
            return search.Organic(uppercase[position], true, 1)
    return none

ParsedAtom | molecule.Problem read_atom(string text, int column, const map<string, molecule.Element> elements)
    if text[0] != "["
        match organic(text)
            search.Organic value
                return ParsedAtom(molecule.Atom(value.element, value.aromatic, column = column), value.consumed)
            none
                return molecule.Problem("unexpected character", column)
    int end_position
    match text.find("]")
        nat found
            end_position = int(found)
        none
            return molecule.Problem("unclosed bracket", column)
    content := text[1:<end_position]
    index := 0
    while index < int(#content)
        if not digit(content[index])
            break
        index += 1
    if index >= 4 or (index > 0 and content[0] == "0")
        return molecule.Problem("bad bracket atom", column)
    mass := 0
    if index > 0
        mass = int(content[0:<index])
    if index == int(#content)
        return molecule.Problem("bad bracket atom", column)
    element := ""
    aromatic := false
    lowercase := "bcnops"
    uppercase := "BCNOPS"
    for: position < 6
        if content[index] == lowercase[position]
            element = uppercase[position]
            aromatic = true
            break
    if aromatic
        index += 1
    elif 65 <= content[index].codepoints()[0] <= 90
        single := content[index]
        read_pair := false
        if index + 1 < int(#content)
            second := content[index + 1]
            if 97 <= second.codepoints()[0] <= 122
                pair := content[index:<index + 2]
                if elements.has(pair)
                    element = pair
                    index += 2
                    read_pair = true
        if not read_pair
            if not elements.has(single)
                return molecule.Problem("unknown element", column)
            element = single
            index += 1
    else
        return molecule.Problem("bad bracket atom", column)
    if index < int(#content)
        if content[index] == "@"
            index += 1
            if index < int(#content)
                if content[index] == "@"
                    index += 1
    hydrogens := 0
    if index < int(#content)
        if content[index] == "H"
            hydrogens = 1
            index += 1
            if index < int(#content)
                if digit(content[index])
                    hydrogens = int(content[index])
                    index += 1
    charge := 0
    if index < int(#content)
        if content[index] == "+" or content[index] == "-"
            sign := if content[index] == "+" then 1 else -1
            index += 1
            amount := 1
            if index < int(#content)
                if 49 <= content[index].codepoints()[0] <= 57
                    amount = int(content[index])
                    index += 1
            charge = sign * amount
    if index != int(#content)
        return molecule.Problem("bad bracket atom", column)
    return ParsedAtom(molecule.Atom(element, aromatic, mass, charge, hydrogens, true, column), end_position + 1)

int bond_symbol(string character, bool pattern)
    if character == "-"
        return 1
    if character == "="
        return 2
    if character == "#"
        return 3
    if character == ":"
        return 4
    if character == "~" and pattern
        return 5
    if (character == "/" or character == "\") and not pattern
        return 1
    return -1

void add_bond(molecule.Molecule &graph, int first, int second, int kind)
    low := if first < second then first else second
    high := if first < second then second else first
    graph.bonds = graph.bonds.append(molecule.Bond(low, high, kind))

Parsed | molecule.Problem parse(string text, const map<string, molecule.Element> elements, pattern := false)
    graph := molecule.Molecule()
    search.Matcher[] matchers := []
    current := -1
    pending_kind := -1
    pending_column := 0
    Branch[] branches := []
    open_rings := array(100, fill = OpenRing())
    index := 0
    while index < int(#text)
        character := text[index]
        column := index + 1
        symbol_kind := bond_symbol(character, pattern)
        if symbol_kind >= 0
            if current < 0 or pending_kind >= 0
                return molecule.Problem("misplaced bond", column)
            pending_kind = symbol_kind
            pending_column = column
            index += 1
        elif character == "("
            if current < 0 or pending_kind >= 0 or (index > 0 and text[index - 1] == "(")
                return molecule.Problem("misplaced branch", column)
            branches = branches.append(Branch(current, column))
            index += 1
        elif character == ")"
            if #branches == 0
                return molecule.Problem("unmatched parenthesis", column)
            if pending_kind >= 0
                return molecule.Problem("dangling bond", pending_column)
            if index > 0 and text[index - 1] == "("
                return molecule.Problem("empty branch", column)
            last := int(#branches) - 1
            current = branches[last].atom
            branches = branches[0:<last]
            index += 1
        elif digit(character) or character == "%"
            if current < 0
                return molecule.Problem("misplaced ring closure", column)
            number := 0
            if character == "%"
                if index + 2 >= int(#text)
                    return molecule.Problem("bad ring number", column)
                if not digit(text[index + 1]) or not digit(text[index + 2])
                    return molecule.Problem("bad ring number", column)
                number = int(text[index + 1:<index + 3])
                index += 3
            else
                number = int(character)
                index += 1
            closing_kind := pending_kind
            pending_kind = -1
            opening := open_rings[number]
            if opening.open
                open_rings[number] = OpenRing()
                if opening.atom == current
                    return molecule.Problem("self bond", column)
                if opening.bond_kind >= 0 and closing_kind >= 0 and opening.bond_kind != closing_kind
                    return molecule.Problem("ring bond mismatch", column)
                first := if opening.atom < current then opening.atom else current
                second := if opening.atom < current then current else opening.atom
                for existing := graph.bonds[]
                    if existing.first == first and existing.second == second
                        return molecule.Problem("duplicate bond", column)
                selected_kind := if closing_kind >= 0 then closing_kind elif opening.bond_kind >= 0 then opening.bond_kind else 0
                add_bond(&graph, opening.atom, current, selected_kind)
            else
                open_rings[number] = OpenRing(true, current, closing_kind, column)
        else
            atom := molecule.Atom("", column = column)
            consumed := 0
            suffix := text[index:<int(#text)]
            if pattern
                match search.pattern_atom(suffix, column)
                    search.PatternAtom parsed
                        matchers = matchers.append(parsed.matcher)
                        consumed = parsed.consumed
                    molecule.Problem problem
                        return problem
            else
                match read_atom(suffix, column, elements)
                    ParsedAtom parsed
                        atom = parsed.atom
                        consumed = parsed.consumed
                    molecule.Problem problem
                        return problem
            next_atom := int(#graph.atoms)
            graph.atoms = graph.atoms.append(atom)
            if current >= 0
                add_bond(&graph, current, next_atom, if pending_kind >= 0 then pending_kind else 0)
            current = next_atom
            pending_kind = -1
            index += consumed
    if pending_kind >= 0
        return molecule.Problem("dangling bond", pending_column)
    if #branches > 0
        return molecule.Problem("unmatched parenthesis", branches[0].column)
    earliest := 0
    for opening := open_rings[]
        if opening.open and (earliest == 0 or opening.column < earliest)
            earliest = opening.column
    if earliest != 0
        return molecule.Problem("unclosed ring", earliest)
    molecule.rebuild(&graph)
    return Parsed(graph, matchers)
